title: Red Hat Security Advisory: pipewire security update
description: A stack overflow vulnerability (CVE-2026-14330) was identified in the Pulse Server component of PipeWire, a multimedia server for Linux and Unix-like systems. Red Hat has issued a security advisory for this vulnerability affecting Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10 and related variants. The vulnerability is rated as moderate in severity. An update to PipeWire is available to address this issue.
